ContextVerifySql.chat: SELECT c."TenantId" FROM "Conversations" c WHERE c."SubjectType" = split_part(@contextRef, ':', 1) AND c."SubjectId" = CAST(split_part(@contextRef, ':', 2) AS uuid) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ConversationParticipants" p WHERE p."ConversationId" = c."Id" AND p."ParticipantId" IN (@caller, @target) AND p."IsActive" = true) = 2 LIMIT 1
ContextVerifySql.chat:counterpart: SELECT p."ParticipantId" FROM "ConversationParticipants" p JOIN "Conversations" c ON c."Id" = p."ConversationId" JOIN "ConversationParticipants" cp ON cp."ConversationId" = c."Id" AND cp."ParticipantId" = @caller AND cp."IsActive" = true WHERE c."SubjectType" = split_part(@contextRef, ':', 1) AND c."SubjectId" = CAST(split_part(@contextRef, ':', 2) AS uuid) AND p."IsActive" = true AND p."ParticipantId" <> @caller AND p."ParticipantId"::text <> c."TenantId"::text AND p."RoleCode" <> 'Guest' ORDER BY CASE WHEN p."RoleCode" = CASE cp."RoleCode" WHEN 'Shop' THEN 'Customer' WHEN 'Customer' THEN 'Shop' ELSE '' END THEN 0 WHEN p."RoleCode" <> cp."RoleCode" THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, (SELECT MAX(m."SentAt") FROM "Messages" m WHERE m."ConversationId" = c."Id" AND m."SenderId" = p."ParticipantId" AND m."IsDeleted" = false) DESC NULLS LAST, p."JoinedAt" DESC
